title: Trump-Xi talks, first Putin trilateral put spotlight on diplomacy at China’s APEC summit
paragraphs: Trump-Xi talks, first Putin trilateral put spotlight on diplomacy at China’s APEC summit
China hosts APEC for the first time in 12 years. High-profile sideline diplomacy is drawing attention amid questions over whether the forum in Shenzhen can deliver more than symbolism.
SHENZHEN: An international free trade forum in an age of tariffs - and the prospect of an unprecedented meeting between three of the world’s most powerful leaders.
